about_the_game:
Description

In this roguelike dungeon crawler, take on the role of Raven, a mysterious woman fighting her way through hell. Defeat enemies, collect their souls, and use them to barter for an arsenal of relics to claim the powers of the Seven Deadly Sins and grow stronger throughout your expeditions.

Hack and slash your way through the ever-changing infernal maze and discover the truth about Raven's motivations, and get to know your only companion; A strange imp who supplies you with the hellish Relics which Raven draws power from.

Experiment with different combinations of Relics in order to build Raven's combat style in millions of ways. Will you have what it takes to battle the legions of hell, emerge victorious, and willingly throw yourself into greater challenges? Or will you be Damned?

Key Features

Roguelike elements with randomized locations, enemies, and upgrades.

Multiple biomes with unique enemies, mechanics, and bosses.

Unique upgrades which allow for millions of possible builds.

Hack and Slash combat.

Isometric camera angle.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains stylized violence and gore. Some items and descriptions contain mature themes.
